_about: Public-domain Angelus Silesius (Johann Scheffler, 1624-1677), German mystic poet, in English translation for the Word Hoard: A Selection from the Rhymes of a German Mystic, translated in the original metre by Paul Carus (Chicago: Open Court, 1909), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

silesius-rhymes-carus: Angelus Silesius: A Selection from the Rhymes of a German Mystic, translated in the original metre by Paul Carus (Chicago: Open Court, 1909)

_alternates.silesius-copies: Another 1909 copy; Kroeger's Rhymed Sayings in the Journal of Speculative Philosophy (1870, a journal article)

_excluded.silesius-later: Flitch (1932) and later selections; a German PG text; anthologies with his hymns
